1042 for name in names { 1043 self.env.insert(name, class.clone()); 1044 } 1045 } 440 refs: BTreeMap>, 441 } 442 443 impl Fields { 444 /// The module, generic scope and raw refs of field `name`. 445 fn field(&self, name: &str) -> Option<(&SymbolId, InScope<'_>, &[Segs])> { 446 Some((&self.module, InScope::of(&self.params), self.refs.get(name)?)) 447 } 448 } 449 450 /// Lookup tables built from all raw files before any resolution. 451 struct Resolver<'p> { 452 /// Which crates each crate's code can name (for name-only guesses). 453 plan: &'p Plan, 454 crates: BTreeSet, 455 /// module id → item name → definitions (items, submodules). 456 items: BTreeMap>, 457 /// module id → `use` entries. 458 uses: BTreeMap>, 459 /// Every internal symbol id that will exist (types, fns, modules, methods). 460 internal: BTreeSet, 461 /// type id → its defining module, its generic parameters and, per field 462 /// name, the field's raw refs. 463 fields: BTreeMap, 464 /// type id → method name → method id (inherent first). 465 methods: BTreeMap>, 466 /// method name → ids, for unknown receivers. 467 by_name: BTreeMap>, 468 /// type id → implemented trait ids. 469 impls: BTreeMap>, 470 /// trait id → method names (required and provided). 471 trait_methods: BTreeMap>, 472 /// module id → internal modules it glob-imports (`use a::b::*`), in 473 /// source order. Resolved once, without consulting globs, so a name 474 /// lookup never re-enters glob resolution. 475 globs: BTreeMap>, 476 } 477 478 impl<'p> Resolver<'p> { 479 fn new(files: &[RawFile], plan: &'p Plan) -> Self { 480 let mut r = Resolver { 481 plan, 482 crates: files.iter().map(|f| f.role.crate_name.clone()).collect(), 483 items: BTreeMap::new(), 484 uses: BTreeMap::new(), 485 internal: BTreeSet::new(), 486 fields: BTreeMap::new(), 487 methods: BTreeMap::new(), 488 by_name: BTreeMap::new(), 489 impls: BTreeMap::new(), 490 trait_methods: BTreeMap::new(), 491 globs: BTreeMap::new(), 492 }; 493 for f in files { 494 for m in &f.modules { 495 let id = module_sym(&m.path); 496 r.internal.insert(id.clone()); 497 r.uses.entry(id.clone()).or_default().extend(m.uses.iter().cloned()); 498 if let Some(parent) = id.parent() { 499 let name = m.path.last().cloned().unwrap_or_default(); 500 r.items.entry(parent).or_default().entry(name).or_default().insert(SymbolKind::Module, id); 501 } 502 } 503 for it in &f.items { 504 let module = module_sym(&it.module); 505 let id = ids::item_id(&module, it.kind, &it.name); 506 r.internal.insert(id.clone()); 507 r.items 508 .entry(module.clone()) 509 .or_default() 510 .entry(it.name.clone()) 511 .or_default() 512 .insert(it.kind, id.clone()); 513 if matches!(it.kind, SymbolKind::Struct | SymbolKind::Union | SymbolKind::Enum) { 514 let refs = it.members.iter().map(|m| (m.name.clone(), m.refs.clone())).collect(); 515 r.fields 516 .insert(id.clone(), Fields { module: module.clone(), params: it.type_params.clone(), refs }); 517 } 518 if it.kind == SymbolKind::Trait { 519 let names = r.trait_methods.entry(id.clone()).or_default(); 520 for m in &it.members { 521 names.insert(m.name.clone()); 522 } 523 for m in &it.methods { 524 names.insert(m.name.clone()); 525 let mid = ids::method_id(&id, None, &m.name); 526 r.internal.insert(mid.clone()); 527 r.methods.entry(id.clone()).or_default().insert(m.name.clone(), mid.clone()); 528 r.by_name.entry(m.name.clone()).or_default().insert(mid); 529 } 530 } 531 } 532 } 533 // Glob targets are resolved up front into a table, so a name lookup 534 // is a bounded graph search (`glob`) instead of a re-entrant `walk`, 535 // which was exponential in the number of globs per module. Round 0 536 // resolves targets without globs; round 1 lets a glob target itself 537 // be found through round-0 globs (`use super::*; use inner::*;`). 538 for round in 0..2 { 539 let mut globs: BTreeMap> = BTreeMap::new(); 540 for (module, uses) in &r.uses { 541 for u in uses.iter().filter(|u| u.alias == "*") { 542 if let Some(t) = r.walk(module, &u.target, None, Ns::Type, 0, round > 0) { 543 if r.items.contains_key(&t) && !globs.get(module).is_some_and(|v| v.contains(&t)) { 544 globs.entry(module.clone()).or_default().push(t); 545 } 546 } 547 } 548 } 549 r.globs = globs; 550 } 551 // Impl methods need item tables to resolve self types; do inherent 552 // impls before trait impls so inherent methods win name lookups. 553 for pass_trait in [false, true] { 554 for f in files { 555 for imp in &f.impls { 556 if imp.trait_.is_some() != pass_trait { 557 continue; 558 } 559 let module = module_sym(&imp.module); 560 let Some(segs) = &imp.self_ty else { continue }; 561 let (ty, _) = r.resolve(&module, segs, None, Ns::Type); 562 if let Some((segs, _)) = &imp.trait_ { 563 let (t, _) = r.resolve(&module, segs, Some(&ty), Ns::Type); 564 r.impls.entry(ty.clone()).or_default().insert(t); 565 } 566 for m in &imp.methods { 567 let mid = impl_method(&module, &ty, imp, &m.name); 568 r.internal.insert(mid.clone()); 569 r.methods.entry(ty.clone()).or_default().entry(m.name.clone()).or_insert(mid.clone()); 570 r.by_name.entry(m.name.clone()).or_default().insert(mid); 571 } 572 } 573 } 574 } 575 r 576 } 577 578 /// Resolve `segs` as written in `module`, looking the final segment up 579 /// in `ns` first. Returns the canonical id and how sure we are. 580 /// Unresolvable paths come back as a path id with 581 /// [`Confidence::External`]. 582 fn resolve( 583 &self, 584 module: &SymbolId, 585 segs: &[String], 586 self_ty: Option<&SymbolId>, 587 ns: Ns, 588 ) -> (SymbolId, Confidence) { 589 match self.walk(module, segs, self_ty, ns, 0, true) { 590 Some(id) if self.internal.contains(&id) => (id, Confidence::Exact), 591 Some(id) => { 592 let in_workspace = id.root().is_some_and(|root| self.crates.contains(root.as_ref())); 593 (id, if in_workspace { Confidence::Inferred } else { Confidence::External }) 594 } 595 None => (ids::path_id(segs).unwrap_or_else(|| ids::unresolved_method_id("")), Confidence::External), 596 } 597 } 598 599 /// [`Self::resolve`] for a path written where the generic parameters 600 /// `params` are in scope. A path through a parameter (`T::new`, 601 /// `Store::Key`) is a bare external path, never walked into an item that 602 /// happens to share the parameter's name. 603 fn resolve_in( 604 &self, 605 module: &SymbolId, 606 segs: &[String], 607 self_ty: Option<&SymbolId>, 608 ns: Ns, 609 params: InScope<'_>, 610 ) -> (SymbolId, Confidence) { 611 if params.heads(segs) { 612 return (ids::path_id(segs).unwrap_or_else(|| ids::unresolved_method_id("")), Confidence::External); 613 } 614 self.resolve(module, segs, self_ty, ns) 615 } 616 617 fn resolve_internal(&self, module: &SymbolId, segs: &[String], self_ty: Option<&SymbolId>) -> Option { 618 self.walk(module, segs, self_ty, Ns::Type, 0, true).filter(|id| self.internal.contains(id)) 619 } 620 621 /// The definition of `name` in module `module`, `ns` first. 622 fn item(&self, module: &SymbolId, name: &str, ns: Ns) -> Option<&SymbolId> { 623 self.items.get(module).and_then(|m| m.get(name)).and_then(|s| s.get(ns)) 624 } 625 626 /// `use_globs` is false only while the glob table itself is being built. 627 fn walk( 628 &self, 629 module: &SymbolId, 630 segs: &[String], 631 self_ty: Option<&SymbolId>, 632 ns: Ns, 633 depth: u8, 634 use_globs: bool, 635 ) -> Option { 636 if depth > 8 || segs.is_empty() { 637 return None; 638 } 639 let first = segs[0].as_str(); 640 let mut rest = &segs[1..]; 641 // Intermediate segments name modules and types; only the last one is 642 // looked up in `ns` first. 643 let ns_at = |i: usize| if i + 1 == segs.len() { ns } else { Ns::Type }; 644 let base: SymbolId = match first { 645 "crate" => module_sym(&[module.root().unwrap_or_default().into_owned()]), 646 "self" => module.clone(), 647 "super" => { 648 let mut m = module.parent().unwrap_or_else(|| module.clone()); 649 while rest.first().map(String::as_str) == Some("super") { 650 m = m.parent().unwrap_or(m); 651 rest = &rest[1..]; 652 } 653 m 654 } 655 "Self" => self_ty?.clone(), 656 name => { 657 if let Some(id) = self.item(module, name, ns_at(0)) { 658 id.clone() 659 } else if let Some(u) = self 660 .uses 661 .get(module) 662 .and_then(|us| us.iter().find(|u| u.alias == name && u.target.as_slice() != [name])) 663 { 664 // Re-resolve the import target, then append the rest. 665 // (`use foo;` — target == alias — would only re-enter 666 // itself; it falls through to the crate check below.) 667 let mut full = u.target.clone(); 668 full.extend(rest.iter().cloned()); 669 return self.walk(module, &full, self_ty, ns, depth + 1, use_globs).or_else(|| ids::path_id(&full)); 670 } else if let Some(id) = use_globs.then(|| self.glob(module, name, ns_at(0))).flatten() { 671 id 672 } else if self.crates.contains(name) { 673 module_sym(&[name.to_owned()]) 674 } else { 675 return ids::path_id(segs); 676 } 677 } 678 }; 679 let offset = segs.len() - rest.len(); 680 let mut cur = base; 681 for (i, seg) in rest.iter().enumerate() { 682 if let Some(id) = self.item(&cur, seg, ns_at(offset + i)) { 683 cur = id.clone(); 684 } else if let Some(id) = self.methods.get(&cur).and_then(|m| m.get(seg)) { 685 cur = id.clone(); 686 } else if self.uses.get(&cur).is_some_and(|us| us.iter().any(|u| &u.alias == seg)) { 687 // `pub use` re-export inside an internal module. 688 return self.walk(&cur, &rest[i..], self_ty, ns, depth + 1, use_globs); 689 } else if i + 1 == rest.len() 690 && self.internal.contains(&cur) 691 && cur.last().is_some_and(|d| *d.suffix() == Suffix::Type) 692 { 693 // A member of an internal type that the code does not define 694 // (`Fingerprint::default()` from a derive, an associated item 695 // from a trait): it still belongs to that type, so it is 696 // `Type#member().` (or `Type#Member#` in type position), never 697 // a kind-free path that would cut it loose from the type. 698 cur = match ns { 699 Ns::Value => ids::method_id(&cur, None, seg), 700 Ns::Type => ids::item_id(&cur, SymbolKind::TypeAlias, seg), 701 }; 702 } else { 703 cur = cur.extend_path(seg); 704 } 705 } 706 Some(cur) 707 } 708 709 /// Find `name` through `module`'s glob imports, following glob chains 710 /// (`pub use inner::*` re-exports) breadth-first. Each module is visited 711 /// at most once, so cyclic globs (`a: use b::*`, `b: use a::*`) are 712 /// harmless and the cost is linear in the glob graph. 713 fn glob(&self, module: &SymbolId, name: &str, ns: Ns) -> Option { 714 let mut queue: std::collections::VecDeque<&SymbolId> = self.globs.get(module)?.iter().collect(); 715 let mut seen: BTreeSet<&SymbolId> = BTreeSet::from([module]); 716 while let Some(m) = queue.pop_front() { 717 if !seen.insert(m) { 718 continue; 719 } 720 if let Some(id) = self.item(m, name, ns) { 721 return Some(id.clone()); 722 } 723 if let Some(next) = self.globs.get(m) { 724 queue.extend(next.iter()); 725 } 726 } 727 None 728 } 729 730 /// Resolve a list of raw type refs to kept relation targets. 731 fn refs(&self, module: &SymbolId, raw: &[Segs], self_ty: Option<&SymbolId>, params: InScope<'_>) -> Vec { 732 let mut out = Vec::new(); 733 for segs in raw { 734 // Generic parameters and their associated types (`T`, 735 // `T::Output`, `Self::Error`) are not symbols. 736 if params.heads(segs) || (segs.len() > 1 && segs[0] == "Self") { 737 continue; 738 } 739 if segs.len() == 1 && PRELUDE.contains(&segs[0].as_str()) && !self.local(module, &segs[0]) { 740 continue; 741 } 742 let (id, _) = self.resolve(module, segs, self_ty, Ns::Type); 743 if (keep_ref(&id) || self.internal.contains(&id)) && Some(&id) != self_ty && !out.contains(&id) { 744 out.push(id); 745 } 746 } 747 out 748 } 749 750 /// `true` if `name` is defined or imported in `module`. 751 fn local(&self, module: &SymbolId, name: &str) -> bool { 752 self.items.get(module).is_some_and(|m| m.contains_key(name)) 753 || self.uses.get(module).is_some_and(|us| us.iter().any(|u| u.alias == name)) 754 } 755 756 fn member(&self, module: &SymbolId, m: &RawMember, owner: Option<&SymbolId>, params: InScope<'_>) -> Member { 757 Member { 758 name: m.name.clone(), 759 kind: m.kind, 760 ty: m.ty.clone(), 761 visibility: m.vis.clone(), 762 span: m.span, 763 refs: self.refs(module, &m.refs, owner, params), 764 } 765 } 766 767 fn add_uses( 768 &self, 769 cb: &mut Codebase, 770 from: &SymbolId, 771 module: &SymbolId, 772 raw: &[Segs], 773 self_ty: Option<&SymbolId>, 774 params: InScope<'_>, 775 ) { 776 for t in self.refs(module, raw, self_ty, params) { 777 let c = if self.internal.contains(&t) { Confidence::Exact } else { Confidence::External }; 778 cb.add_relation(Relation::new(from.clone(), t, RelationKind::Uses, c)); 779 } 780 }
